description: Transform your Power BI reports with our advanced Matrix visual, designed for professionals who need more control over their data presentations. Whether you’re a business analyst, data professional, or financial expert, this visual is tailored to enhance your ability to analyze and present hierarchical data, performance metrics, or financial reports. Addressing the limitations of standard visuals, it offers customizable layouts, dynamic conditional formatting, intuitive drill-downs, overwrite data capacity, and tracking usage functionality. Say goodbye to cluttered and confusing dashboards – our Matrix visual helps you deliver actionable insights with precision and ease, meeting the needs of modern data-driven decision-making. Some features on the visual require extra purchase and acquiring a license to fully use the visual.
